The '''Fifth Squadron''', also know as "The Ice Birds", was a starfighter squadron of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It participated in the [[Battle of Ilum]] during which Sergeant [[Pell (Nautolan)|Pell]] was shot down.<ref name="TOR" />
